description: Current sources. 'limits' rows are the machine tables: scheme (series | parallel | pairs), detonator id (null = not stated), max count (ЭД, or pairs for 'pairs') and max total network resistance. 'set' tells which book set the source belongs to.

items.name: КПМ-3
notes: Table 3.1 does not name the detonator type; the Praktikum applies it to ЭДП (2,5 Ом).

Detonator type not printed; applied to ЭДП as in the Praktikum (user decision 2026-11-15).

items.name: КПМ-1А
notes: Table 3.2 is titled 'Возможности машинки КПМ-3' but stands in the КПМ-1А section; its series/parallel values equal RPR КПМ-1 for ЭДП. Taken as КПМ-1А.
prakt2023 sheet 12 (problem 2) lists КПМ-1А as 'до 130 пар', contradicting Table 3.2 (60 пар). Table 3.2 is used.
Two КПМ-1А joined by the cable are 'approximately equal to КПМ-3' (sheet 220): qualitative only, no table.
Detonator type not printed; applied to ЭДП as in the Praktikum (user decision 2026-11-15).

corrections.evidence: Table stands in the КПМ-1А section (sheet 221); series/parallel rows equal RPR КПМ-1 for ЭДП (Table 7, sheet 65).

items.name: ПМ-4

items.name: КВП-4/100
